name: Copperkettle Roast
purpose: Online store for a small coffee roaster: browse roasts with photos and prices, add to cart, check out, and let signed-in customers review their past orders.
actors: Customers (guest checkout or signed-in; signed-in customers see past orders)

entities.name: Product
relationships: belongs to the catalog with name, description, price, photo, roast level, origin, available flag

entities.name: Order
relationships: belongs to a Customer (or guest email)

entities.name: OrderItem
relationships: snapshots product name, quantity, unit price at purchase

workflows.name: Browse catalog
workflows.description: View roasts with photos, prices, roast level and origin; open a product detail page

workflows.name: Cart
workflows.description: Add products to a cart, adjust quantities, see the running total

workflows.name: Checkout
workflows.description: Check out as guest (email only) or signed-in; order goes through the server-authoritative flow with a receipt

workflows.name: Past orders
workflows.description: Signed-in customers see their order history and order details

workflows.name: Admin
workflows.description: Admin manages products (add, edit, price, photo, availability) and views orders

seed_demo: Five roasts (light to dark) with photos, prices, roast level and origin; a sample past order for the demo customer so order history is visible.
